newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CNS downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CNS downgraded to hold.

text.p: - Dain Bosworth said it downgraded its rating on CNS Inc to a hold from a buy based on inconclusive sales data of the CNS' Breathe Right nose strip during this cold season.

- Dain Bosworth also said that indications from CNS are not convincing that U.S. fourth quarter sales will meet its $22.5 million estimate. CNS is in a quiet period and cannot comment on fourth quarter operations except to say that it sees no reason for concern, Dain Bosworth said in a report.

- Dain Bosworth noted that values exist in CNS including brand name awareness, patents, distribution and co-marketing arrangements, a balance sheet with no debt and $3 a share in cash and equivalents.
- Shares of CNS were trading off 1-1/8 to 14-3/4.
